Press the Attack
Instant1 min cooldown
Requires Shields
Raise your shield and press the attack, dealing 75% Weapon Damage plus 18+2.8 Points Per Level to enemies in front of you and draining 10 Energy every 0.5 sec. Lasts 5 sec.

While active you gain 100% increased block chance and you may block, dodge, and parry while channeling.

You cannot use other abilities while Press the Attack is active.
